scope: Four short Qwen2.5-1.5B Q4_K_M generation runs, three decode API calls per context, including four-token prefill
interpretation: The candidate applies to Q8_K four-row preparation, not single-row decode or an already-reused activation. Call counts are neither cycle shares nor a speedup estimate.
current_gate: Both real K sizes appear in the accepted combined-ISA numerical gate; current RTL performance measurement covers M4/N1536/K1536 only.
integration_constraints: Preserve Q8_0 Zvfh selection and default-OFF opt-in until performance acceptance.
Keep row tails, wide-M preparation and reused-activation paths unchanged.
The enable switch is cached in a function-local static: use fresh processes for OFF/ON model runs.
Do not generalize a K1536 timing result into a measured K8960 or whole-model speedup.
